trusted_setup_append:
for rh2_service_wait in $(seq 1 240); do
  [ -f /tmp/rh2-docker-ready ] && break
  sleep 1
done
[ -f /tmp/rh2-docker-ready ] || { echo RH2_SETUP_ERROR=docker_service_not_ready; exit 1; }
scope: dedicated rootless daemon; same private no-network namespace; no host bind/socket; sidecar 1CPU/2GiB/PID512 additional to grader
